proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ _ A B hi
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hc : (Bᶜ.card : ℝ) + B.card = Fintype.card Ω := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_compl_add_card B
  have hs : ((A ∩ Bᶜ).card : ℝ) + (A ∩ B).card = A.card := by
    have hd : Disjoint (A ∩ Bᶜ) (A ∩ B) := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro x hx hx'; simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_compl] at hx hx'; exact hx.2 hx'.2
    have hu : (A ∩ Bᶜ) ∪ (A ∩ B) = A := by
      ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_compl]; tauto
    have := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd
    rw [hu] at this
    exact_mod_cast this.symm
  have e : ((A ∩ Bᶜ).card : ℝ) = A.card - (A ∩ B).card := by linarith
  have e' : (Bᶜ.card : ℝ) = Fintype.card Ω - B.card := by linarith
  rw [e, e', sub_div, hi]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (A B : Finset Ω), ((A ∩ B).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω = ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) * ((B.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) → ((A ∩ Bᶜ).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω = ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) * ((Bᶜ.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω)
